release_notes: Brighton punk duo. Double single from the second album No Refunds, due Jan. 15, 2027.
"The Basement" deals with online radicalisation. "Spilt" is an acoustic song about alcohol dependency (Kerrang!).
Release date Oct. 20, 2026 comes from one source.
draft_comment: Lambrini Girls come back with two contrasting singles, one loud and one acoustic, ahead of No Refunds.
